why: The KMX front door must retain its create/prove/lift journey, runnable quickstart, and runtime and migration boundaries. Synthetic positive and negative fixtures must detect lost markers, lost ordering, and a neutered command-line verdict without depending on archived README text.

mutations.name: the ketu icon marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The compact project identity can disappear from the front door unnoticed.

mutations.name: the product line marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The Agent-specific KMX promise stops being required.
mutations.find: ("product line", r"^\*\*Agent Builder CLI for Kubernetes\.\*\*$"),

mutations.name: the runtime contract marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can lose the link between the simple journey and its runtime boundary.

mutations.name: the migration marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can omit the separate migration section.

mutations.name: the status marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can omit current status and limitations.

mutations.name: the documentation marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The page can lose its documentation navigation.

mutations.name: the install revision check is dropped
mutations.breaks: An obsolete tagged CLI or an empty revision can satisfy the current quickstart prerequisite.

mutations.name: the journey create marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The simple journey can omit Agent creation.

mutations.name: the journey lift marker matches anything
mutations.breaks: The simple journey can omit lifting the Agent.

mutations.name: a word boundary accepts obsolete quickstart command names
mutations.breaks: A hyphenated non-command can satisfy the runnable quickstart step.

mutations.name: the journey command list is emptied
mutations.breaks: Any fenced block can satisfy the journey without create or lift.

mutations.name: the quickstart command list is emptied
mutations.breaks: Any fenced block can satisfy setup without containing its commands.

mutations.name: the badge list is emptied
mutations.breaks: The README can lose all status and project metadata badges.

mutations.name: command order is searched from the top of the block
mutations.breaks: Commands can appear before their prerequisites and still satisfy the sequence.

mutations.name: marker order is searched from the top of the file
mutations.breaks: The hierarchy becomes a set of headings rather than ordered navigation.

mutations.name: the script entry point is neutered
mutations.breaks: The verdict never reaches CI as an exit code.
